question: Can the currently deployable decision-time representation distinguish the optimal zero-cost action from the other zero-cost candidates on FORGE_SYMMETRIC_V2?

hypotheses.H1: POLICY_IMPLEMENTATION_LIMITATION: the deployable state already carries the information; current policies do not use it
hypotheses.H2: REPRESENTATION_LIMITATION: the deployable state does not carry enough action-conditioned information

eligibility.candidates: the distinct legal zero-cost actions of the presented symmetric surface (declared cost 0)
eligibility.target: binary optimal-set membership of each candidate (oracle); the decision is correct when the chosen candidate is in the optimal set
subpopulations: MIXED_OPTIMAL_SET (optimal set also contains a costly action)

contract.candidates: the distinct legal zero-cost actions of the presented symmetric surface (declared cost 0)

contract.tieRule: uniform over the top-scoring set; identities never break ties

stateFeatures.audit: all 30 certified DEPLOYABLE by Stage 3F.6-T-SYM (edd46e40); D4-invariant on every twin (P.1D gate)

audit.declared: every inventory entry carries its declared class; only DEPLOYABLE entries may be headline columns
empirical: NON_EQUIVARIANT if the deployable vector of any candidate differs on any D4 twin (every 25th row, 5 transforms) of any evaluated partition
NON_EQUIVARIANT if replaying with identities replaced and the legal list reversed changes any vector
LEAKED if any single deployable column separates optimal from non-optimal candidates with pooled candidate AUROC (max of a, 1 - a) >= 0.99 on DEV
UNAVAILABLE if any deployable value is non-finite
audit.downgradeRule: a failing column is reported and dropped from the headline; nothing is silently replaced

models.family: CONDITIONAL_LOGIT_CANDIDATE_SOFTMAX (linear candidate scorer, softmax within state, set-valued target: maximise log P(optimal set))
models.optimiser: DEV standardisation of every column, zeros init, no bias, l2 1e-3, learning rate 0.1, 2000 full-batch iterations (the Stage 3F.6-T settings)
models.interactions: an `interact` block is also entered as block x each of the 30 state features (raw product, then standardised)
models.stateOnly: STATE_ONLY: candidate identity is reduced to its declared type (the minimum that names a candidate); every MOVE is identical, so it chooses uniformly among MOVEs
models.calSelection: the headline STATE+CANDIDATE model is the SC_* variant with the highest CAL top-1 accuracy; ties within 1e-9 -> fewer columns

D_ABSOLUTE_DIRECTION.question: how much does the presented absolute direction buy (orientation shortcut)?

D_CANONICAL_FRAME.question: how much does the privileged canonical-frame direction buy?

D_HIDDEN_ORIENTATION.question: how much does the hidden base-frame direction (generator bias) buy?

D_PRIVILEGED_RELATIONS.question: would observing where task entities are (action semantics relative to entities) suffice?

D_ONE_STEP.question: would a one-step successor prediction suffice?

models.tieRule: uniform over the top-scoring set; identities never break ties

controls.UNIFORM_AMONG_ZERO_COST: exact expectation of a uniform choice among the zero-cost candidates
controls.LOWEST_ACTION_ID: zero-cost candidate with the lowest identity (control: identity order)
controls.HIGHEST_ACTION_ID: zero-cost candidate with the highest identity (control: identity order)
controls.FIXED_DIRECTION_EAST: MOVE EAST in the presented frame if legal, else uniform (control: absolute direction); likewise NORTH, SOUTH, WEST
controls.HIDDEN_BASE_EAST: the MOVE whose generator base-frame direction is EAST if legal, else uniform (ORACLE_ONLY control: hidden orientation)

policies.RESOURCE_ID_REVERSED: RESOURCE re-run with identities reversed, mapped back
policies.NEXUS_SELECTOR_V1: the stored choice on eligible rows where it proposes (coverage reported; may be costly)

references.GREEDY: the stored simulator one-step greedy choice over all legal actions (non-deployable reference)
references.ONE_STEP_ZERO_COST: argmax one-step immediate scalar among zero-cost candidates, uniform ties (FUTURE_STATE_REQUIRED reference)

heuristics.NON_WAIT_UNIFORM: uniform among zero-cost candidates that are not WAIT (deployable type heuristic)
heuristics.RETREAT_ALIGNED: if a RETREAT is legal: uniform over the RETREAT and the MOVE aligned with it; else uniform over MOVEs (deployable, P.1A fields)
heuristics.TOWARD_CENTRE: uniform among MOVE/RETREAT candidates that reduce centre distance, else uniform among zero-cost (deployable, GEOMETRY fields)

partitions.FRESH_HOLDOUT: PRIMARY confirmatory: 6000 new records from the declared, unused P.1D HOLDOUT seed 2023 (levels 0-5, canonical order)
partitions.FRESH_OOD: PRIMARY robustness: 6000 new records from the declared, unused P.1D OOD seed 2033 (levels 6-7, canonical order)
partitions.TSYM_HOLDOUT: SECONDARY replication: the Stage 3F.6-T-SYM fresh HOLDOUT (seed 2022); policy-level outcomes were evaluated there, candidate models never
partitions.TSYM_OOD: SECONDARY replication: the Stage 3F.6-T-SYM fresh OOD (seed 2032), likewise
partitions.excluded: the P.1D/P.1E HOLDOUT and OOD (RESOURCE shortcut was diagnosed on them)
partitions.freshAdmission: P.1D corpusRecord (unchanged) in canonical order; reject any record, world or topology hash already claimed by the 20000-row lineage, the T-SYM fresh 12000, or earlier in the new set; equivariance sampled every 25th combination
partitions.freshGeneration: only after this plan, the open-phase report and all evaluation code are committed unchanged at HEAD

perDecision: TOP1_ACTION_ACCURACY (= OPTIMAL_SET_HIT_RATE of the chosen candidate, expectation over uniform ties)
P_OPTIMAL_SET (model probability mass on the optimal set)
NORMALIZED_REGRET (regret / max regret over all legal actions)
ABSTENTION: not supported (every scorer always chooses)
metrics.bootstrap: paired over eligible rows, 1000 resamples, mulberry32 seeded by sha256(label) (Stage 3F.6-P.1E bootstrapPlan)

equivariance.featureEquivariance: share of (twin, candidate) pairs whose deployable vector equals the base vector after mapping back; required 1
equivariance.predictionEquivariance: share of twins whose top-scoring candidate set, mapped back, equals the base top set; required 1 for headline models
equivariance.idPermutation: share of rows whose deployable vectors are unchanged when identities are replaced and the list reversed; required 1
equivariance.orientationStability: on FRESH_HOLDOUT the headline model gain over UNIFORM in every hidden orientation >= 0.5 x its overall gain (only when the overall gain > 0)
equivariance.shortcutDetection: the D_ABSOLUTE_DIRECTION diagnostic is scored on twins with transformed directions; its prediction equivariance is reported (expected < 1, proving the test can fail)

materiality.MATERIAL: top-1 gain >= 0.05 with paired 95% CI lower bound > 0, and normalized regret not significantly worse (CI lower bound of the difference <= 0)
materiality.sufficientBar: REPRESENTATION_SUFFICIENT additionally requires FRESH_HOLDOUT top-1 >= 0.5 (a majority of dominant free decisions correct)
materiality.statisticalOnly: statistical significance below the gain bar is reported, never called sufficient

errorAttribution.population: residual errors of the headline STATE+CANDIDATE model on FRESH_HOLDOUT and FRESH_OOD, each row weighted by 1 - its expected hit
errorAttribution.sets: O = optimal zero-cost candidates; W = non-optimal members of the top-scoring set
precedence: OBJECTIVE / RESOURCE / THREAT / RELATIONAL (PARTIAL_OBSERVABILITY): the first privileged relation group (objective entity; material or resources; hostiles or threatened; critical or dependency hubs) whose nearest-distance change strictly separates O from W
MECHANISTIC: the one-step immediate scalar strictly separates O from W (visible in a one-step transition)
TEMPORAL: the row is HORIZON_DEPENDENT and nothing above separates
ACTION_ID_AMBIGUITY: not horizon-dependent and O and W are identical in deployable, privileged and one-step fields (only identity differs)
errorAttribution.multiLabel: every separating relation group, MECHANISTIC, and DEPLOYABLY_DISTINGUISHABLE (the deployable vectors of O and W differ at all) are also counted (multi-label incidence); DEPLOYABLY_DISTINGUISHABLE is never a primary class because a difference in deployable fields does not show that they carry the answer
errorAttribution.role: diagnostic only; it names which Stage 3G capability the data calls for and never creates an expert

precedence: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE if eligible FRESH_HOLDOUT < 1000 or FRESH_OOD < 500
REPRESENTATION_SUFFICIENT_POLICY_WEAK if MATERIAL vs both comparators on FRESH_HOLDOUT and FRESH_OOD, equivariant and stable, and FRESH_HOLDOUT top-1 >= 0.5
REPRESENTATION_PARTIALLY_SUFFICIENT if the same holds with top-1 < 0.5

SHORTCUT_ONLY_GAIN if MATERIAL on FRESH_HOLDOUT but not equivariant/stable, or not MATERIAL while a decision-time shortcut (D_ABSOLUTE_DIRECTION, LOWEST/HIGHEST_ACTION_ID, FIXED_DIRECTION_*) is MATERIAL vs UNIFORM and vs the evaluated model on FRESH_HOLDOUT (D_ABSOLUTE_DIRECTION extends the headline candidate spec and is compared with that model only); ORACLE_ONLY and LEAKED diagnostics are reported, not counted
conclusions.secondary: every other category whose condition holds is listed, plus OOD_UNSTABLE when material on FRESH_HOLDOUT but not FRESH_OOD
preFreezeRevisions: The two rules below were revised BEFORE the freeze commit, after a dry run of the confirmatory code on CAL rows standing in for the sealed partitions (DEV/CAL only; no fresh row existed): (1) SHORTCUT_ONLY_GAIN originally counted ORACLE_ONLY/LEAKED diagnostics, which always beat UNIFORM, so every non-material model would have read as shortcut-only; (2) the error taxonomy originally had a REPRESENTED_BUT_MISRANKED primary class that fired whenever deployable vectors differed at all (95% of CAL residuals), which would have been misread as evidence for H1.

The dry run also added a guard (a comparison over zero rows is never material) and restricted D_ABSOLUTE_DIRECTION to the model it extends (compared with STATE_ONLY it credited the geometry columns, not the shortcut).

roadmap.CURRENT_POLICY_SHORTCUT_CONFIRMED: FRESH_HOLDOUT: RESOURCE minus RESOURCE_ID_REVERSED top-1 CI lower > 0 AND RESOURCE top-1 in hidden orientations that keep EAST as EAST minus the others >= 0.15 with CI lower > 0
roadmap.POLICY_REPAIR_JUSTIFIED: headline STATE+CANDIDATE category is SUFFICIENT or PARTIALLY_SUFFICIENT (a deployable scorer materially beats the current policy, equivariantly and OOD-stably)
roadmap.ACTION_SEMANTICS_REQUIRED: not DEPLOYABLE_CANDIDATE_REPRESENTATION_SUFFICIENT and D_PRIVILEGED_RELATIONS minus the headline model >= 0.05 top-1 with CI lower > 0 on FRESH_HOLDOUT
roadmap.TRANSITION_PREDICTION_REQUIRED: not DEPLOYABLE_CANDIDATE_REPRESENTATION_SUFFICIENT and D_ONE_STEP minus the headline model >= 0.05 top-1 with CI lower > 0 on FRESH_HOLDOUT
roadmap.PREDICTIVE_REPRESENTATION_REQUIRED: not DEPLOYABLE_CANDIDATE_REPRESENTATION_SUFFICIENT and (ACTION_SEMANTICS_REQUIRED or TRANSITION_PREDICTION_REQUIRED or TEMPORAL >= 0.25 of weighted FRESH_HOLDOUT residual error)
roadmap.READY_FOR_3F_FREEZE: false: 3F.6-P.1, W and D requalifications remain
